_comment: First date with an indexable per-date page. Launched 2026-10-26 with the 7 most recent days; later days are added as they are released. Do not move these dates earlier without a rollout plan (see docs/daily-date-pages-plan.md). Read by lib/date-pages.ts and scripts/generate-date-page-images.mjs.
_wordle: Wordle history before this date (#0 from 2021-06-19 on) is data only: no /wordle-hint/[date] pages, and the existing pages keep their range. Only getFullWordleHistory() (e.g. /wordle-repeats) reads further back.
